title: Maximum Swap
description:
Given a non-negative integer, swap at most two of its decimal digits once. Return the largest value that can be obtained.

## Examples

```text
Input: num = 2736
Output: 7236
```

```text
Input: num = 9973
Output: 9973
```

## Constraints

- `0 <= num <= 10^8`
